prompt.default: A ladder leans against a wall. How long is the ladder? Measure it and give your answer in metres, to 2 decimals.
prompt.$comment: the example's instruction is translated with data-language

scene.$comment: JSON written by the authoring mode: { objects: [{ id, type, name, size, position, rotation, measurable }], names: { pointId: name } }; empty: the example (a ladder against a wall and a crate)

target.$comment: JSON written by the authoring mode: { kind: length, points: [id, id] }, { kind: angle, points: [id, vertex id, id] }, { kind: area, face: id } or { kind: volume, object: id }; empty with the example scene: the ladder

label.en: Answer: the candidate types the value
label.nl: Antwoord: de kandidaat typt de waarde

label.en: Tool: the answer goes elsewhere in the item
label.nl: Hulpmiddel: het antwoord staat elders in het item

label.en: Ruler: between two tick marks, the candidate rounds
label.nl: Liniaal: tussen twee streepjes, de kandidaat rondt af

label.en: Ruler: a tick mark every (in the unit)
label.nl: Liniaal: een streepje per (in de eenheid)

label.en: Scale: 1 unit of the scene is … (in the unit)
label.nl: Schaal: 1 eenheid van de scène is … (in de eenheid)

label.en: The tools apply the scale (off: they read units, the candidate converts)
label.nl: Het gereedschap rekent de schaal om (uit: het leest eenheden, de kandidaat rekent om)

label.en: Margin: how far off still counts as correct
label.nl: Marge: hoeveel ernaast nog goed is

label.en: Response processing: the value within the margin
label.nl: Responsverwerking: de waarde binnen de marge

label.en: PCI scoring: the right measurement must have been made
label.nl: PCI-score: de juiste meting moet gedaan zijn

label.en: Show the names of the vertices
